name: Forward Flow for Novel View Synthesis of Dynamic Scenes
definition: A dynamic NeRF approach that replaces backward flow deformation with forward flow to warp a canonical radiance field to target time steps, ensuring smooth and continuous motion modeling.
summary: Forward Flow is a dynamic novel view synthesis method that uses forward flow warping with explicit voxel grids and inpainting to ensure smooth motion modeling, unlike backward flow methods that cause discontinuities.
